title: Amazon shaman with a wife in the spirit world

tellings.quote: shaman in the Amazon whose wife left him because of his wife in the spirit world

plain: There is a shaman in the Amazon whose wife left him because he also had a wife in the spirit world. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this as something he was told by someone else. He uses it to show how real the spirit world is to the people who visit it.
